subject.title: [Bug] WebChat: new session loses all prior conversation context - AI 'blind' on session start

question: Should a new WebChat session automatically receive prior same-channel context, or should model-facing session tools remain tree-scoped unless the user/operator explicitly opts into broader history visibility?
rationale: The code-level restriction is clear, but choosing the fix changes the product contract for session continuity and the security boundary for transcript access.

options.title: Add bounded same-channel bridge
options.body: Create an explicit same-user, same-channel recent-context path that gives WebChat continuity without opening unrelated agent sessions.

options.title: Keep tree default and improve UX/docs
options.body: Preserve the current privacy boundary and make WebChat show that a new session is intentionally clean unless configured otherwise.

options.title: Make broader history opt-in
options.body: Add a documented opt-in policy or setup control for cross-session continuity while leaving upgrades on the current tree default.

recommendation.title: Add bounded same-channel bridge
recommendation.body: Create an explicit same-user, same-channel recent-context path that gives WebChat continuity without opening unrelated agent sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The current visibility policy and security scoping trace most directly to steipete's session-tool commits, making this the best available decision owner from history.
